QuestionStmt.S: Which from following statement is correct regarding emf of cell for the cell reaction, $$\mathrm{Cd_{(s)} + Cu_{(aq)}^{2+} \rightarrow Cd_{(aq)}^{2+} + Cu_{(s)}}$$ if concentration of Cd²⁺ is 10 times greater than concentration of Cu²⁺ at 298 K.

Solution.S:
For the cell reaction: $\mathrm{Cd_{(s)} + Cu_{(aq)}^{2+} \rightarrow Cd_{(aq)}^{2+} + Cu_{(s)}}$.

Nernst equation: $E_{\text{cell}} = E_{\text{cell}}^\circ - \frac{0.0591}{n} \log \frac{[\mathrm{Cd^{2+}}]}{[\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}]}$.

Here $n = 2$.

Given $[\mathrm{Cd^{2+}}] = 10 \times [\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}]$, so $\frac{[\mathrm{Cd^{2+}}]}{[\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}]} = 10$.

$$E_{\text{cell}} = E_{\text{cell}}^\circ - \frac{0.0591}{2} \log(10) = E_{\text{cell}}^\circ - 0.02955 \approx E_{\text{cell}}^\circ - 0.0296$$

Thus $E_{\text{cell}}$ is less than $E_{\text{cell}}^\circ$ by 0.0296 V, which corresponds to option D.
